projects.title: AUREL Intake and Analytics Platform
projects.summary: A platform for service intake and request prioritisation, with secure administration and behavioural analytics.
projects.details: The project combines a public intake flow, service and request management, secure authentication, explainable prioritisation and analytics. It was taken through to a working production-style environment with automated tests, Docker deployment and HTTPS.
projects.focus: How to bring intake, security, transparent prioritisation, analytics and infrastructure together in one working system.

projects.title: Business Intake and Triage Assistant
projects.summary: A system that turns an unstructured business request into a clear processing route.
projects.details: The service validates the request, identifies key facts and missing information, recommends a route and next actions, prepares a response for the requester and stores the reasoning for audit.
projects.focus: How to preserve context and decision transparency when an LLM participates in request processing.

projects.title: Mini CRM with Google Reports
projects.summary: A compact CRM connecting an API, desktop interface and automated Google Sheets reporting.
projects.details: Customers, deals and tasks are managed in one workflow; test data can be generated for validation, while reports and analytics are produced through Google APIs.
projects.focus: How to connect a local application, backend and external services in one end-to-end workflow.

projects.title: Google Sheets Report Automation
projects.summary: A system for automatically preparing management reports in Google Sheets.
projects.details: A reusable client manages spreadsheet operations and formatting, while a desktop interface lets the user select the period, business area and currency.
projects.focus: How to turn a Google Sheets integration into a reusable user-facing tool rather than a one-off script.

projects.title: AI Documentation RAG Agent
projects.summary: A system that ingests selected documentation and makes it possible to ask questions about its contents.
projects.details: Documents are indexed in a vector database, after which a Telegram interface retrieves relevant passages and generates an answer grounded in the connected sources.
projects.focus: How to ground answers in a defined knowledge corpus and make documentation search convenient in conversation.

projects.title: Telegram Bot with Vector Memory
projects.summary: A Telegram assistant with per-user semantic memory and clear user control.
projects.details: The system maintains separate memory for each user, retrieves relevant context, detects semantic duplicates and lets users review or delete stored information.
projects.focus: How to make long-term memory useful without taking control of the data away from the user.

experiments.title: Rise and Shine
experiments.summary: A personal experiment with multimodal scenarios and the ways different kinds of input can participate in one user experience.
experiments.focus: Exploring multimodality, context and interaction between a user and an AI system.

experiments.title: MoodMuse
experiments.summary: An experimental project exploring multimodality, mood and generative interaction.
experiments.focus: Exploring how different signals and formats can create a more expressive and context-aware AI experience.

experiments.title: Weather Teller
experiments.summary: A small experiment with third-party APIs and turning external data into a clear user-facing response.
experiments.focus: External-service integration, API response handling and tool orchestration.
